answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature makes its value unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward. Binding the task and its commit-reveal transcript to that pulse prevents sybil swarms from precomputing answers or farming offline; the signal is fresh, whether the task context names a wharf or yarrow. Beacon timing raises the cost of advance preparation, though identity or resource controls are still needed to limit live participants.
